// AUTO-GENERATED outer-tiled MX matmul baseline (41x512x512).
void solution(void) {
  // Pre-stage scale buffers once for all blocks, amortizing the restriding
  // cost across all BLOCKS_M * BLOCKS_N iterations.
  const int GK = MATMUL_K / 32;

  // Static pre-staged scale arrays: [block_idx][scale_group][elem_in_block]
  // Sized for the maximum number of blocks along each dimension.
  static uint8_t pre_A_s[BLOCKS_M][MATMUL_K / 32][BLK];
  static uint8_t pre_B_s[BLOCKS_N][MATMUL_K / 32][BLK];

  // One-time restride: copy from strided A_scales_row[g][i0*BLK] into
  // contiguous pre_A_s[i0][g][0..BLK-1], done once before the main loop.
  for (int i0 = 0; i0 < BLOCKS_M; i0++)
    for (int g = 0; g < GK; g++)
      memcpy(&pre_A_s[i0][g][0], &A_scales_row[g][i0 * BLK], BLK);

  for (int j0 = 0; j0 < BLOCKS_N; j0++)
    for (int g = 0; g < GK; g++)
      memcpy(&pre_B_s[j0][g][0], &B_scales_col[g][j0 * BLK], BLK);

  const int tiles = BLK / DIM;
  const int tiles_K = MATMUL_K / DIM;
  const uint32_t a_base = 0;
  const uint32_t b_base = BANK_NUM * BANK_ROWS - tiles * tiles_K * DIM;
  const int SPAD_DEST = 128;

  // Single flush before all computation — resets accelerator state once.
  gemmini_flush(0);

  // j0-outer loop: B block (tiles + scales) is fixed for all i0 iterations.
  for (int j0 = 0; j0 < BLOCKS_N; j0++) {
    int ncols = REAL_N - j0 * BLK; if (ncols > BLK) ncols = BLK; if (ncols <= 0) continue;

    // Configure execution once per j0 (format unchanged across j0, but
    // re-issue after flush and before scale loads to satisfy ordering).
    gemmini_extended3_config_ex(WEIGHT_STATIONARY, 0, 0, ACC_SCALE_IDENTITY,
                                1, 1, 0, 0, false, 0, 0, 3, 0);

    // Load B scales once per j0 (sel=1 for B/weight scales).
    gemmini_mx_load_scales((uint64_t)pre_B_s[j0], B_S_BYTES, 1);

    // Mvin all B tiles for this j0 block once (hoisted out of i0 loop).
    gemmini_config_ld(MATMUL_N * sizeof(elem_t));  // B row stride = N
    for (int j = 0; j < tiles; j++)
      for (int k = 0; k < tiles_K; k++)
        gemmini_extended_mvin2(
          (void*)(((elem_t*)B_in) + (k * DIM) * MATMUL_N + (j0 * BLK + j * DIM)),
          b_base + (k * tiles + j) * DIM, DIM, DIM);

    // i0-inner loop: only A scales and A tiles change per iteration.
    for (int i0 = 0; i0 < BLOCKS_M; i0++) {
      int mrows = REAL_M - i0 * BLK; if (mrows > BLK) mrows = BLK; if (mrows <= 0) continue;

      int pad_i = BLK - mrows, pad_j = BLK - ncols;

      // Load A scales for this i0 block (sel=0 for A/activation scales).
      // B scales (sel=1) remain valid from the load above — not overwritten.
      gemmini_mx_load_scales((uint64_t)pre_A_s[i0], A_S_BYTES, 0);

      // Mvin A tiles for this i0 block.
      gemmini_config_ld(MATMUL_K * sizeof(elem_t));  // A row stride = K
      for (int i = 0; i < tiles; i++)
        for (int k = 0; k < tiles_K; k++)
          gemmini_extended_mvin(
            (void*)(((elem_t*)A_in) + (i0 * BLK + i * DIM) * MATMUL_K + k * DIM),
            a_base + (i * tiles_K + k) * DIM, DIM, DIM);

      // Configure requantized mvout (must match tile dimensions for loop_ws_spad).
      gemmini_config_st(BLK_OUTC * sizeof(out_t));
      gemmini_mxquant_config_mvout((uint64_t)scale_factors,
                                   tiles, tiles, tiles_K,
                                   /*scale_act_sel*/0, /*scale_w_sel*/0,
                                   /*lut_update_granularity*/1);

      // Compute: funct 24 (LOOP_WS_CONFIG_SPAD_AB) is re-issued inside
      // gemmini_loop_ws_spad before every funct 8 (LOOP_WS) call.
      gemmini_loop_ws_spad(tiles, tiles, tiles_K, pad_i, pad_j, 0,
                           a_base, BANK_NUM * BANK_ROWS, 0, SPAD_DEST,
                           false, false, false, false, false,
                           NO_ACTIVATION, 0, 0, false, 0x38);

      // Drain BF16-packed results from mx_smem to DRAM, row by row.
      for (int r = 0; r < mrows; r++)
        gemmini_mx_read_smem(&C_hw[i0 * BLK + r][(j0 * BLK) / BF16_PER_WORD],
                             SPAD_DEST * 16 + r * BLK, ncols);
      gemmini_fence();
    }
  }
}
